rules.description: Kuking: anonimowe przekierowania zdjec - wlacz dopiero po odbiorze
rules.expression: (http.host eq "kuking.pl" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zdjecia/") and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne ""))

rules.description: Kuking: HTML goscia bez ciasteczek (#610) - wlacz po KUKING_HTML_EDGE_CACHE_SECONDS>0 i odbiorze sondy
rules.expression: (http.host eq "kuking.pl" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/przepisy/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/@")) and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne ""))

rules.description: Kuking: ostatnia regula - nigdy nie wspoldziel stanu klienta
rules.expression: (http.host eq "kuking.pl" and (http.cookie ne "" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or http.request.uri.query ne "" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/livewire/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ustawienia") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/konto/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/login" "/register" "/logout"}))
